g.text: Backend — request path, single write path, CDC
Reads and commands enter at httpd. Only session_manager and lifecycle mutate durable
facts. Adapters are reachable only through the interfaces in ports/.
service/ — the read and command surface
Display status and kanban column are derived here, on read. Never stored.
native controllers, detached ACP host, durable projection
The only code allowed to move a durable fact.
A failed probe is not proof
of death. A session terminates only
when runtime and process are both
One write path for durable change: database triggers append to change_log.
Store methods never emit events by hand.
